What is CBD?

CBD is a substance that is derived from the hemp plant. Following filtration and distillation to break apart the individual components, a cannabinoid-rich oil is produced, which is more well-known as cannabidiol or CBD. CBD is the non-psychoactive part of the hemp plant, which means you can experience all the positive effects without experiencing the dizzying ‘high’ feeling.

 

What is CBD Isolate?

CBD isolate is pure CBD which has been specially processed to effectively isolate the CBD from the rest of the compounds in the hemp plant. This means it contains no THC – not even trace amounts – which means you can enjoy your CBD E-liquid safe in the knowledge that it won’t have any psychoactive effects on the body. It’s also ideal for athletes or those worried about drug testing, as even though our full-spectrum CBD products contain less than 0.2% THC which has no psychoactive effects and is 100% legal in the EU and UK, CBD isolate has no traces of THC whatsoever.

What do the terms VG and PG mean?

VG stands for Vegetable Glycerine, which is typically made from palm oils or coconut oils, it is an odourless liquid that has a mild taste to the tongue. Whereas PG is an acronym for Propene Glycerol. It can be used as an ingredient in foods or cosmetic products.

The ratio of Vegetable Glycerine to Propene Glycerol is 60:40 within the 50ml bottle. This allows the perfect base to effectively infuse CBD and allows it to quickly absorb into the body. This ratio also provides the optimal balance between CBD delivery and delicious grape flavour.

name: Zeus Grime Sticks
description:
• ZEUS Grime Sticks are cotton swabs that are filled with ethyl alcohol that can be used to clean various vaporizer components, most notably, heating chambers. Ethyl alcohol differs from traditionally used isopropyl alcohol as it is the same type of alcohol contained in alcoholic beverages. This means that it is much safer for use as a cleaner than isopropyl alcohol and works just as effectively. ZEUS Grime sticks are unique and easy to use as they feature a quick snap top that releases the ethyl alcohol into one durable cotton end, making cleaning very easy and mess free. Regularly cleaning your vaporizer components helps maintain high-quality and fresh vapor, so anyone with a vaporizer can benefit from keeping a pack of these on hand.
  • 20x Grime Sticks
  • Remove ZEUS Grime Stick from package.

    Snap top of Grime Stick on the indicated line.

    Let the alcohol drain to the swab end.

    Use the alcohol-moistened end to clean the metal, glass or ceramic component of your vaporizer.

    Discard Grime Stick.

    Rinse external vaporizer component or heat up the vaporizer to remove excess ethyl alcohol particles in chamber.

    Repeat as needed.

name: WoodWynd Flame Powered Extraction Device (Padauk)
description:
DynaVap WoodWynd

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

Arguably one of DynaVpa’s most beautiful dry herb extraction devices yet. The WoodWynd features the stunning Titanium Helix Tip, a completely new Titanium Helix Mouthpiece and XL Condenser and of course that eye catching Wood Stem. DynaVap have opted for a more understated design with this wood stem which really lets the wood shine for what it is. The thinnest part of the wood stem is right at the airport making it extremely easy to locate. The smooth feel of the wood adds a layer of comfort to the feel of the WoodWynd.

Features

  • DynaVap Helix Tip: The Helix Tip is constructed out of Titanium, featuring a triple helix design with 3 convection ports which are located on the side of the chamber. This is DynaVap’s lightest tip they have so far created yet has thicker walls than other titanium tips. This adds to its ability to hold heat for longer periods which means you will be up to extraction temperature for longer with each heat cycle.
  • Adjust-A-Bowl: This is a feature of the tip itself. There are 2 positions where the CCD screen can be positioned. One position being full and the other gives you a half bowl size. To adjust the size of your bowl from full to half. Use the included condenser to push it up into the half bowl slot by inserting the condenser tube up through the bottom of the tip. This is done with the tip removed from the stem. Be sure to rest your finger on top of the tip while adjusting so your CCD doesn’t go flying across the room. To move the CCD screen from half to full simply push it back down using the condenser. Keep in mind, constant adjustment often reduces the life of a CCD.
  • WoodWynd Condenser & Mouthpiece: Constructed entirely out of titanium and 2 High Temp O-Rings. The WoodWynd Condenser and Mouthpiece are seperate pieces that click together using no o-rings to hold it in place. The WoodWynd Mouthpiece will also allow connection to 10mm female joints.
  • The WoodWynd Stem: This ergonomic design is currently constructed out of Padauk wood. And uses stainless steel crowns to support and protect the wood. The use of stainless steel crowns also ensures a consistent fit with both the tip and mouthpiece.
  • Captive Cap: A standard now for most Dynavap’s is the Captive Cap. This is constructed out of medical grade stainless steel and is where a lot of the magic happens. And every DynaVap cap lives 2 heat sensitive plates which will click once they reach a certain temperature. You will find the clicks happen one after the other and never at the same time. While the plates do click at a consistent temperature you are still able to achieve a wide range of temperatures by the method you use to heat the cap. The clicks purpose is to help you achieve constant results at around what ever temperature affect you are aiming for.

Why Choose DynaVap

  • Durability: Given that the WoodWynd has no electrical components. With care it can last a lifetime. At some point you may need to replace a High Temp O-Ring or two or maybe a CCD screen. But you can bet if you pull your DynaVap out of your draw while sitting back at a retirement village. It will be ready to roll.
  • Extremely Efficient: Dynavap is the sort of device that basically pays for itself due to the amount of herb you save compared to other devices. It is certainly more efficient than combustion but it is also more efficient than most other dry herb extraction devices on the market. It really is amazing how much affect you get from such a little amount of herb when using a device like DynaVap’s WoodWynd.
  • All You Need Is A Heat Source: This can be anything from a basic Bic Lighter to a fang dangle Induction Heater. Even a candle will do if need be. But in general best results are found using Jet Lighters or Induction Heaters.
  • Flavour At Your Fingertips: DynaVap has the ability to really make your herbs flavour shine. When chasing a more flavoursome experience a faster heat up is usually best.
  •  You Play A Huge Roll In The End Result: There is some general instruction to follow when using any DynaVap. But at the end of the day you usually end up with your own variation on how you like to use the WoodWynd. Don’t get too hung up on trying to exactly copy another persons technique. Use other examples as a guide to find that perfect technique for how you like your vapour. DynaVap’s WoodWynd will rip hard if you want or if you prefer a more whispy flavoursome vapour, the option is there for you too. And of course everything in between. The WoodWynd is for sure a device to experiment with.

Below Are DynaVap’s Instructions On Use

  • Remove the Cap
  • Load your dry herb into the Tip chamber/bowl
  • Place the Cap back on the Tip
  • Heat the Cap with a torch or Induction Heater until it Clicks (this takes ~5-7 seconds)
  • Inhale from the mouthpiece end
  • The Cap will click again when it has cooled down
  • You can either
    • Heat your Cap up again for more extraction
    • Save your ABV or later uses (if your bud is done)
    • Store your WoodWynd for the next session

The above instruction that DynaVap provide is a great place to start. But if you are new to DynaVap it will take a bit of trial and error to really dial in your technique. Things you will need to experiment with are the use of the airport, type of heat source and how intense that source is. And of course your inhale rate. You will very likely get affective results straight out of the gate. But with some time it will only get better as you really figure out this system.

Storage

The WoodWynd is an XL sized device therefore requires an XL storage option if choosing a case from dynavap. For Example a XL DynaStash or XL SlimStash.

Included

  • 1 x WoodWynd (Padauk)2

name: Utillian 8 Ruby Pearl Pack
description: The Utillian 8 is known for being extremely user-friendly and providing features such as ruby terp pearls that allow your concentrates to flourish with flavor. The ruby terp pearls come included in the original U8 purchase and can also be purchased separately when in need. The terp pearls are meant to be placed into the chamber with your wax, which allows them to spin around the atomizer, effectively breaking your wax up and reducing the chance of wax puddles forming. This help keep your chamber clean, but it also spreads the concentrate around the 3D atomizer, which heats all surfaces evenly, so you don’t have to worry about some parts of your atomizer getting cold, like when you are using a traditional non-electric rig.

name: Utillian 8 Multi-Tool
description: With the brand-new Utillian 8 multi-tool, users can forget the additional accessories that usually come separately when purchasing an e rig. Connoisseurs can substitute the carb cap, dab tool, and choke with this intuitive part, making the Utillian 8 extremely simple and convenient. Because the tool extends a few millimeters above the bowl, it helps you to properly agitate your heated material, much like a traditional non-electric rig. This means you can get through a session without opening the carb cap to see how spent your material is, leaving less of it in the air around you and more in your hits.

name: Utillian 8 Glass Mouthpiece
description: The Utillian 8 Glass Mouthpiece is instrumental to what makes the U8 such a sophisticated device. Due to its slight tint and narrow form factor, cleaning becomes a breeze. This mouthpiece is identical to the original that comes with the Utillian 8 e rig. The bubbler can be purchased separately for those in need of a replacement. To use the glass mouthpiece, fill it up just above the two air holes you will find on its side, and you are ready to start vaporizing. If you are experiencing splashbacks of water when taking a hit, remove a bit of water or reduce the intensity of your inhale.

name: Utillian 8 E Rig Concentrate Vape Device
sourceName: Utillian 8 E Rig Concentrate Vape Device
description:
• The Utillian 8 E Rig offers the most sophisticated vaporization experience for those who use high-quality concentrates. With this e rig, Utillian integrated the safety and convenience that battery-powered vaporization offers with the cooling and hydration effects that water bubblers are known for. The U8’s features are designed to efficiently extract all active components in your wax, allowing even the most basic concentrates to taste heavenly while packing a punch. This electric wax rig features a ceramic and stainless steel BurstHit 3D heating chamber with terp pearls right out of the box. The integrated multi-tool is a feature that allows users to choose between hot and cold loading and prevents the need to carry multiple sticky tools, keeping your device mess-free for longer. These features combined make the U8 one of the most desirable e rigs on the market.4 Pre-set Temperatures: The Utillian 8 offers four temperature levels for vaporizing sessions. The first two range from 204°C (400ºF) to 316°C (600ºF), while the highest level can reach up to 800ºF for maximum wax extraction and enormous clouds.

    The U8 features a 3150 mAh battery that allows you to enjoy around 30 sessions on a single full charge. The integrated auto shut-off turns off the device when not vaporizing, saving your battery life for active sessions.

    The LED lights indicate when it’s time to start your session. Controlling your session with the intuitive single-button interface is very easy. These LEDs are located around the button and at the base of the bubbler for visibility.

    The narrow style of bubbler that the U8 features helps to prevent splashback during percolation, and the slight tint helps to keep your device looking clean for longer. Now you can enjoy more sessions without needing to clean your glass bubbler constantly.

    The Utillian 8 features an aluminum body housed in a cover that uses fabric and plastic to create a sleek design. Not only is the U8 stylish, but it’s also customizable with a removable fabric cover and bubbler. The fabric cover is attached with magnets and provides a comfortable grip to hold on to while operating the multi-tool. The built-in tool functions as a choke, wax tool, and carb cap for added convenience.

    The Utillian 8 provides many features that allow it to efficiently vaporize all active ingredients in your wax, such as the BurstHit 3D atomizer, which comes equipped with terp pearls. The addition of these features allows even the simplest concentrates to taste amazing.

This new design from dynavap produces a lot more convection vs conduction compared to the traditional dynavap cap. That BallR cap is not the only interested feature of the UniDyn. This design also has the tip and stem as one piece. With a removable and adjustable mouthpiece and condenser assembly. You can easily adjust the length of the condenser by sliding it in and out into various different grooves. This gives you consistent adjustability when it comes to air/vapour mix.

UNIDYN FEATURES

  • One-piece UniBody stem and tip combination for a seamless design
  • Lightweight titanium construction for durability and portability
  • Stainless steel CCD (screen) for optimal filtration
  • XL length paired with the BallR Cap for enhanced performance
  • Mouthpiece fits a 10mm taper for water pipe adaptability
  • Adjustable condenser with 7 airflow settings for a personalized draw
  • Compact design fits in an XL-length stash
  • Easy-to-locate airport for intuitive airflow control
  • Serrated tip designed for breaking up material on the go
  • Adjust-a-Bowl feature for microdosing flexibility
  • HypoTherm™ heat break reduces heat transfer
  • Bowl Size 0.1g
  • Only 2 total O-rings for simple maintenance

Like just about anything dynavap related. You can expect a bit of a trial and error period. Even if you are very well accustomed to using Dynavap with their traditional caps, you will find some tweaks and where you heat and possibly even flame size are necessary to get the best out of it. So like always, if you aren’t getting ballr results straight away, keep playing around with your process until you find what works best for you.

name: The Armored Cap
description:
The Armored Cap

The Armored Cap by Dynavap is one of the best creations to come out of Dynavap for quite some time. This is a real game changer for butane torch users. This new stainless steel cap retains heat for a lot longer than a standard cap. This means you will have the temp in the sweet spot for longer, giving you the ability to roast through a bowl in 1-2 heat cycles. If you are at all a fan of Dynavap, this is a must have.

Let’s hear what Dynavap have to say about this breakthrough accessory

By popular demand, the Armored Cap is upon us. This upgrade to your dry herb vaping experience contains a Captive Cap encased in a stainless steel shell. Designed with torch users in mind the armored cap shines when heated slowly (without the need to spin) and is capable of full extractions in 1-2 heat cycles.

The original geometry of the cap has been kept by machining grooves to locate your captivations and utilize the digger outer when needed. This product has a matte grey finish on stainless steel that will patina through usage. The additional mass in the cap allows for slower, longer, and more thorough extractions whether you’re on the couch or on the go. Unlike previous versions of the cap the Armored cap is preadjusted for fitment and designed to be a tighter fit on the tip to prevent the hot cap from falling off accidentally.


The Armored Cap may have gotten bigger, but the branding gets smaller. The machined captivations and logo placement can be used as a visual reference on device heating. The Armored Cap will fit in any DynaVap stash when assembled onto a device. 

Features:

  • Higher mass for longer and further extraction
  • Standard captivations
  • Machined heating references

 

Induction Heater compatibility varies due to the increased diameter of the cap (12mm). When used with an induction heater it may require multiple heat cycles to achieve the same results as a torch. Does work with The Wand (no adaptor).
The Armored Cap retains heat for an extended period of time and has therefore been designed with a tighter fit on your VapCap tip to reduce the likelihood that it will fall off during use. As a result, the Armored Cap may scratch certain titanium and PVD colored tips and caution should be used in the placement and removal of the Armored Cap from your device. Scratches are normal and do not affect the performance of our tips or present a health risk. 

Included

name: Simrell FMJ Full Metal Jacket (For CAPTIVE CAPS Only)
sourceName: Simrell FMJ Full Metal Jacket (For CAPTIVE CAPS Only)
description:
Full Metal Jacket (FMJ)

The FMJ from Simrell collection is designed to retain heat for longer giving you the ability to consume your bowl in one heat cycle. Each FMJ is constructed out of 99.99% copper. This material is extremely affective at retaining heat.

Please Note: The FMJ will only work with captive caps. If you were to use this on a standard cap it would not stay on the tip. Cap is NOT included.

Simrell’s Instructions on its use

Our signature logo is more than a symbol of authenticity. The logo on the FMJ serves as a visual reference point for your torch.

For the perfect heat up, direct the flame at the Simrell logo. As the copper heats up, it will begin to change colour. When this “hot-spot” is the size of the logo, you’re at the perfect distance to heat the cap. Once it clicks, you will have approximately 60 seconds to clear the bowl.

Important Note About Installation

Simrell intends for the FMJ to be installed with the logo closest to the mouthpiece end. During installing you will find it is a snug fit. Sliding it on from the top of the cap (Closed end) seems to be the easiest method.

It is possible that you could find some slight adjustment is needed to get your captive cap and FMJ to fit well together and snap onto the Dynavap tip. Some people have found it useful to slightly widen the gap in the cut that runs down the side of the FMJ. In general though it is more likely it will slide on into place with little fuss. A tight fit is optimal.

 

Included

  • 1 x Simrell FMJ Full Metal Jacket

The Simrell XL condenser fits the larger XL sized MVS. This size condenser is also suitable for Dynavap’s larger sized stems of approximately 62mm such as the OMNI, VONG and M range of vaporizers. There is a rubber o-ring on the inside of this WPA that holds a simrell condenser tube in place. This also give you the ability to adjust the length of you condenser tube by pushing it in or backing it out. When you back the condenser tube out it pushes the tip of the condenser tube closer to the opening of your dynavap tip. the closer to the tip the condenser goes, the less air that will come through your air port. This is extremely handy on a standard dynavap stem like the M as it effectively gives you the same sort of adjustment as you get with the OMNI range from dynavap.

Please Note: If buying this adapter for use with a dynavap stem. You will also need a Simrell Collection condenser tube. The standard dynavap condensers will be a loose fit as they are not as large of a diameter as the Simrell condenser tubes. 

Need a Simrell Condenser Tube to fit your new Simrell Collection 14mm WPA? Find your Simrell Condenser Tube HERE.

This water pipe adapter will also fit some whip hoses with an inside diameter of 7mm or smaller. Although you may have trouble getting the whip in place if your whip has an inside diameter of less than 4mm. it does not fit the larger type of whip hose but the commonly used thinner type will fit.

Included

  • 1 x Simrell Collection 14mm WPA (Titanium)

name: Shorty Vortex & Intercooler VapCap
description:
Shorty Vortex & Intercooler

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

Take your dynavap experience to the next level with the all titanium Vortex by Simrell Collection. A true premium stem that has been crafted to the highest quality.

This vapcap is complete and ready to roll. It includes the Simrell Collection Vortex & Intercooler, Titanium Tip (Dynavap) and Cap (Dynavap).

The Small Vortex midsection means this vapcap will fit in a standard dynastash. And while this midsection is smaller then the xl sized vortex it still has the same vapour conditioning as the xl size.

What makes the Vortex so special

Besides the beautiful understated design there is quite a bit going on with this stem.

Offset Teardrop Airport : This is where things get interesting. Because the airport is offset to the side, when air enters it immediately spirals around the inner tube towards the dynavap tip creating a vortex. This helps cool the inner tube and also helps pull vapour from the herb chamber. The teardrop airport also enables easy adjustment to the amount of air that is let in through the airport.

The Intercooler : The intercooler is made from medical grade titanium and is another key feature to the Vortex Stem. Once the air from the airport and vapour have met up at the base of the dynavap tip it then is sent through the spiraled intercooler. This lengthens the vapour path considerably which aids in the cooling and conditioning of your vapour.

Summary

To summarize the vortex experience is not that easy to put into words. If you are well accustomed to the dynavap experience then you will quickly notice the differences. There is truly something magical going on with the vortex and huge credit has to go to Austyn the creator for putting yet another great dynavap compatible product out there for us all to enjoy.

The Vortex is a great option for the dynavap lover. Particularly if you have previous experience with other dynavap vaporizers. If this is to be your first vapcap then some of its charm may not be so well defined without having used other vapcaps.

Included

  • 1 x Simrell Shorty Vortex & Intercooler
  • 1 x Storage Tube
  • 1 x Dynavap Titanium Tip
  • 1 x Dynavap The Cap

name: Screwball by Chubby Treatz - 60ml Longfill
description:
Screwball by Chubby Treatz | 60ml Longfill

Screwball Longfill E-Liquid

Indulge in the nostalgia of a classic summer treat with Screwball Longfill E-Liquid. This deliciously crafted blend combines the smooth creaminess of vanilla ice cream with the bright, tangy sweetness of raspberry syrup. To top it all off, a playful bubblegum finish rounds out the flavour, making it a perfect blend for those who crave dessert-inspired e-liquids. Experience the joy of a timeless screwball treat in a bottle, all without chasing down the ice cream truck!

What is a Longfill E-Liquid?

Are you in search of higher nicotine strengths in a larger bottle? Longfill E-Liquids might be for you! What exactly is a 60ml Longfill? It’s a 60ml bottle that includes 30ml of flavour concentrate (in your choice of 50VG/50PG or 70VG/30PG), allowing for customisation of nicotine strengths. These are paired with the correct set of 10ml nicotine boosters to create your desired strength.

How to use:

  1. First, choose your preferred nicotine strength and ratio. We recommend 70/30 for higher-powered sub-ohm devices, and 50/50 for smaller MTL/pod kit devices.
  2. Next, add the provided ingredients – nicotine and/or booster shots – into the 60ml Longfill bottle.
  3. Finally, shake well, leave to stand for a few minutes, and it’s ready for you to enjoy.

Please note: Longfills are not ready to use and require mixing before use. For more details, visit our Simplified Guide To Longfills.

name: Quartz Convection Cap for Dynavap devices (The Rogue Wax Works)
sourceName: Quartz Convection Cap for Dynavap devices (The Rogue Wax Works)
description:
DV02 Quartz Convection Cap by Rogue Wax Works

You just can’t beat the performance of hot Quartz as your heater. It may not be as efficient when heating it up (although I could be wrong) it certainly is efficient at transferring heat into passing air for the purpose of extracting that goodness from your plant material. In this little kit you get two different versions. One being the 2mm thick Ripper and the other a 1.25mm thick Sipper. And both are glorious.

The Rogue Wax Works quartz convection caps can be used in to general ways. One is in conjunction with dynavaps standard cap which will allow you to still use the sound of that click to guide you to a consistent temperature. And that is a viable option as the glass does give you that extra storage of heat meaning you will stay in the sweet spot longer before needing to reheat. But I will say using the DV02 Quartz caps without dynavaps standard cap is what give the most rewarding experience. It truely give dynavap another gear in both outright performance and flavour.

Caution. Extra care is needed

One thing you should be well aware of with TRWW Quartz Convection Caps is that they sit loose on the dynavap tip or cap. So you always need to use it tilted upwards or completely upright in a water pipe. The quartz gets extremely hot and it will burn you if torched after heating. Be absolutely sure it isn’t still hot before handling.

When using these Quartz Convection Caps be sure to have a safe place to sit hot caps down where they will not roll off a table. When hot you can simply tip the device holding the cap over so it falls into a safe location. A bowl is ideal for this.

The Sipper

The sipper is made of 1.25mm Quartz glass and is best suited to chasing flavour and temp stepping your way up through a single bowl. This provides a nice all round experience. But at the same time this little sipper does also rip.

The Ripper

The rippers is made of chunky 2mm thick quartz glass. As Rogue Wax Works puts it. This one is “one and done”. Feed it some heat once and rip completely through a bowl. The ripper is ideal for water pipe use.

If you are considering going down this path it will be a great idea to jump on TRWW’s website where he has some videos of the Quartz Convection Caps in action. Videos can be found HERE.

Dynavap NOT included

name: Purple Heart XL Vortex & Intercooler by Simrell Collection
sourceName: Purple Heart XL Vortex & Intercooler by Simrell Collection
description:
Purple Heart XL Vortex & Intercooler

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

Take your dynavap experience to the next level with the Purple Heart Vortex by Simrell Collection. A true premium stem that has been crafted to the highest quality.

The use of purple heart wood really brings a lot of comfort to your fingers and lips while in use. Wood does not heat up nearly as much as the titanium version so longer sessions do not lead to a uncomfortably hot stem.

Please Note: DynaVap Tip & Cap Not Included

What makes the Vortex so special

Besides the beautiful understated design there is quite a bit going on with this stem.

Offset Teardrop Airport : This is where things get interesting. Because the airport is offset to the side, when air enters it immediately spirals around the inner tube towards the dynavap tip creating a vortex. This helps cool the inner tube and also helps pull vapour from the herb chamber. The teardrop airport also enables easy adjustment to the amount of air that is let in through the airport.

The Intercooler : The intercooler is made from medical grade titanium and is another key feature to the Vortex Stem. Once the air from the airport and vapour have met up at the base of the dynavap tip it then is sent through the spiralled intercooler. This lengthens the vapour path considerably which aids in the cooling and conditioning of your vapour.

Summary

To summarize the vortex experience is not that easy to put into words. If you are well accustomed to the dynavap experience then you will quickly notice the differences. There is truly something magical going on with the vortex and huge credit has to go to Austyn the creator for putting yet another great dynavap compatible product out there for us all to enjoy.

The Vortex is a great option for the dynavap lover, particularly if you have previous experience with other dynavap vaporizers. If this is to be your first vapcap then some of its charm may not be so well defined without having used other vapcaps. Still, you can’t go wrong with a vortex.

name: OmniVong Light Wood
description:
OmniVong Light Wood

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

The OmniVong has all the adjustability of the omnivap with the addition of a 14mm wood midsection making it possible to connect to most 14mm female glass joints.

The entire DynaVap range is created around one of the most unique and exciting heating systems around. And is seriously fun to use and experiment with as you find the right technique that yields the result you are looking for.

How Do You Use It

To use the OmniVong the cap is heated using a lighter (usually a torch lighter) until you hear a click. It’s time to take your draw as you feather your finger on and off the carb/air inlet hole until you find the sweet spot. After two or three draws the cap will click again signifying the temperature has dropped below the optimum temperature and will either need reheating or repacking.

One of the best things about the OmniVong is that you can find your own technique that produces the sort of vapour you like. Unlike electronic vaporizers that are limited in adjustability your actions play a big part in the results.The Omnivong vapour quality can also be altered by a twist of the mouthpiece which moves the condenser tube closer to the tip. This changes the vapour air mix and once dialed in will produce more consistent results

Only A DynaVap Owner Knows The Feeling

There is something truly special about the OmniVong that you can only know once you have one in your hands. Don’t want to sound like a pushy salesman but words and pictures can only say so much. You just have to experience it for yourself.

Features

  • Titanium Omni Mouthpiece
  • 14mm light wood Midsection

description:
HydroBrick Maxx

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

The HydroBrick Maxx by Sticky Brick Labs is the most advanced and versatile Sticky Brick to date. It is a semi portable desktop extraction device that has most of what you need self contained inside the hardwood body of the HydroBrick Maxx. Inside the max there is a wooden pick, flame intake and corked glass tube to store your herb.

On Demand Convection

All Sticky Bricks are true on demand convection extraction device. Nothing heats up as fast as a butane powered jet light. As butane is used as the heat source, be sure to use high quality multi refined butane.

Multiple Trick Pony

The HydroBrick Maxx can be used dry with the included dry mouthpiece, a lot like the OG Brick. And can be connected for water diffusion with the included whip connector. The HydroBrick Maxx can connect to anything with a 18 or 14mm female connection.

Beautiful Hardwood Construction

All Sticky Bricks are hand crafted out of natural hardwood. It’s this construction method that breaths so much character into their devices. Every Sticky Brick is different and unique and has its own personality. As they are all handcrafted it is not unusual to see subtle imperfections and differences.

The HydroBrick Maxx is made up of 3 blocks that are held together by extremely strong magnets. And is a joy to use. Who doesn’t love playing with magnetic blocks.

Using The HydroBrick Maxx

All of the Sticky Brick Lab devices do have a slight learning curve. Once you figure out the perfect mix of draw speed and torch position you are rewarded with a premium vapour experience. Whether you’re after low temp tasty draws or monster clouds the Sticky Brick range can deliver.

Lifetime Warranty

The great people of Sticky Brick Labs offer a lifetime warranty on the hardwood body and a 15 day manufacturing warranty on glass. Glass is however very strong and is made of Simax Borosilicate glass. It would take a serious knock to damage any part of your HydroBrick Maxx.

Restrictor Disks Now Included

A new edition to all sticky bricks are the inclusion of restrictor disks. Your new Maxx will come with 2 of these. Only one of these will need to be used at any given time with a second spare.

Restrictor disks make using the hydrobrick maxx that much more consistent and also a lot easier to use straight out of the box. Please do experiment though as using with or without provides a different experience.

HydroBrick

The HydroBrick is designed for use with a water pipe. While this is it’s main function a dry mouthpiece can be added resulting in a similar experience to the OG Brick.

Straight out of the box the HydroBrick can be used with a hydratube. If you wish to use your HydroBrick with your own existing glass then you will need to choose the whip connector option with the correct sized connectors to fit your glass.

Unbelievable Flavour. When you get your technique right all sticky bricks produce some of the tastiest experiences you could ever get from an extraction device

On Demand Convection

All Sticky Bricks are true on demand convection device. Nothing heats up as fast as a butane powered jet light. As butane is used as the heat source, be sure to use high quality multi refined butane.

Beautiful Hardwood Construction

All Sticky Bricks are hand crafted out of natural hardwood. It’s this construction method that breaths so much character into their extraction device. Every Sticky Brick is different and unique and has its own personality. As they are all hand crafted it is not unusual to see subtle imperfections and differences between Sticky Bricks.

The HydroBrick is made up of 3 blocks that are held together by extremely strong magnets. And is a joy to use. Who doesn’t love playing with magnetic blocks.

Using The HydroBrick

All of the Sticky Brick Lab devices do have a slight learning curve. Once you figure out the perfect mix of draw speed, flame size and torch position you are rewarded with a premium vapour experience. Whether you’re after low temp tasty draws or monster clouds the Sticky Brick range can deliver.

Lifetime Warranty

The great people of Sticky Brick Labs offer a lifetime warranty on the hardwood body and a 15 day manufacturing warranty on glass. Glass is however very strong and is made of Simax Borosilicate glass. It would take a serious knock to damage any part of your HydroBrick Maxx.

Restrictor Disks Now Included

A new edition to all sticky bricks are the inclusion of restrictor disks. Your new Junior will come with 2 of these. Only one of these will need to be used at any given time with a second spare.

Restrictor disks make using the hydrobrick that much more consistent and also a lot easier to use straight out of the box. Please do experiment though as using with or without provides a different experience.

description:
XL Vortex & Intercooler

Take your dynavap experience to the next level with the all titanium Vortex by Simrell Collection. A true premium stem that has been crafted to the highest quality.

Please Note: Cap Not Included

Anodising done in house at HTV

What makes the Vortex so special

Besides the beautiful understated design there is quite a bit going on with this stem.

Offset Teardrop Airport : This is where things get interesting. Because the airport is offset to the side, when air enters it immediately spirals around the inner tube towards the dynavap tip creating a vortex. This helps cool the inner tube and also helps pull vapour from the herb chamber. The teardrop airport also enables easy adjustment to the amount of air that is let in through the airport.

The Intercooler : The intercooler is made from medical grade titanium and is another key feature to the Vortex Stem. Once the air from the airport and vapour have met up at the base of the dynavap tip it then is sent through the spiraled intercooler. This lengthens the vapour path considerably which aids in the cooling and conditioning of your vapour.

Summary

To summarise the vortex experience is not that easy to put into words. If you are well accustomed to the dynavap experience then you will quickly notice the differences. There is truly something magical going on with the vortex and huge credit has to go to Austyn the creator for putting yet another great dynavap compatible product out there for us all to enjoy.

The Vortex is a great option for the dynavap lover. Particularly if you have previous experience with other dynavap vaporizers. If this is to be your first vapcap then some of its charm may not be so well defined without having used other vapcaps.

name: Gold Platted Copper Dynavap Sleeve
description:
Gold Platted Copper Dynavap Sleeve

The Gold Platted Copper Dynavap sleeve is made out of copper and is coated with real Gold. This Coating means it will hold its shine unlike uncoated copper sleeves.

What this sleeve does is add a whole heap of heat retention to your dynavap cap. This keeps you at vaporizing temperature for longer. Giving you the ability to consume a bowl in one good heat cycle. Two at the most.

If you are familia with the Simrell FMJ which is also constructed out of copper. This gold Platted Copper Sleeve is a touch thinner than the Simrell FMJ. So you can expect this Gold Platted Sleeve to get you to the click faster but won’t hold its heat for quite as long as the Simrell FMJ.

Whether you already have a FMJ or Armored Cap, this Gold Platted Copper Sleeve is still very much worth adding to your collection as it does indeed give you a different experience. You still do get that extended time at vaporizing temperature compared to the standard cap but because it is a little thinner than the Armored cap or Simrell FMJ, you will find the flavour is a little better on this sleeve.

Installation

This sleeve is best used with Dynavap’s captive caps. It can also be used with Dynavap’s standard caps but you may need to work the sleeve into the right shape to get it to hold on to your liking.

You will most likely find your Gold Sleeve slides straight on and that is all that is needed. But if yu would like some extra pressure to hold your cap on the Gold Platted Copper Sleeve can very easily be adjusted by simply squishing it inwards. This is made easy via the slit at the rear of the gold Sleeve.

PLEASE NOTE: Dynavap cap or full vaporizer is NOT included. Only the gold sleeve is included.

name: ELEV8R Flame Powered Extraction Device Rig Kit
sourceName: ELEV8R Flame Powered Extraction Device Rig Kit
description:
ELEV8R Rig Kit

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

Introducing the latest from 7th Floor and Elev8 Glass. The Elev8r is refreshingly simple yet kicks it with the best of them.

The Rig Kit version of the Elev8r is a stripped down kit. But what is included is everything you need to enjoy the elev8r through your 14mm rig.

The Elev8r is a full convection extraction device that can be attached to any glass rig with a 14mm female glass joint.

It should also be mentioned that the Elev8r is not the easiest device to use and does take some setting up before you are ready to go but once you have the technique dialled in it becomes a really unique and enjoyable experience.

Water Attachment

The Elev8r really is king in water. Whether you are using dry herb or concentrate the Elev8r is right at home in your favourite rig.

Massive Draws

The Elev8r has no problem in the power department. The strength of the heat produced from the elev8r heater is totally up to you. And does have the capability to combust. Not that you are trying to combust but does speak volumes for its power.

How Its Used

To use the Elev8r the glass heater is heated using a butane torch for approximately 45 seconds. (This time will vary greatly depending on how powerful your torch is). Then it’s as simple as taking a draw through your preloaded herb or ceramic disk with concentrate. Generally you will get two to three draws before you need to reheat.

 Caution

While the elev8r is one hell of an extraction device extra care is needed to ensure you do not burn yourself, safety first. The glass heater reaches extremely high temperatures and any contact with this heater while hot will result in injury.

The Elev8r really is king in water. Whether you are using dry herb or concentrate the Elev8r is right at home in your favourite rig.

Massive Draws

The Elev8r has no problem in the power department. The strength of the heat produced from the elev8r heater is totally up to you. And does have the capability to combust. Not that you are trying to combust but does speak volumes for its power.

How Its Used

To use the Elev8r the glass heater is heated using a butane torch for approximately 45 seconds. (This time will vary greatly depending on how powerful your torch is). Then it’s as simple as taking a draw through your preloaded herb or ceramic disk with concentrate. Generally you will get two to three draws before you need to reheat.

All Glass Option

For the purist out there elev8 have come up with an alternative to the big stainless steel screen used in both the wand and water attachment. This steps up a notch the cleanliness of the vapour path and gives a subtle edge in the flavour department. The all glass have glass screens with 19 small holes filtering out your herb. These holes do let a little more fine herb through and do slightly increase the draw resistance. But still the all glass has very little draw resistance just not as free flowing as the standard. The diameter of the herb chamber is also reduced in the all glass. This may be an advantage for those wanting to consume smaller amounts.

Standard Option

The standard elev8r is the tried and true version that has proved itself for being a serious contender against any vaporizer on the market. The difference of course being the standard has stainless steel screens. This option filters out smaller particles better, has better air flow and a slightly bigger diameter chamber. Particularly at screen level. Downside to this version being an extra screen which can effect flavour. Most may not notice this difference but for some purity is everything.

Caution

While the elev8r is one hell of a vaporizer extra care is needed to ensure you do not burn yourself, safety first. The glass heater reaches extremely high temperatures and any contact with this heater while hot will result in injury.

Heater Care

As glass is fragile one thing that you should be aware of is the need to heat the glass heater as evenly as possible. Usually twirling the heater while heating is enough to avoid any stress fractures.

description:
Lemon Drizzle by Chubby Treatz | 60ml Longfill

Lemon Drizzle Longfill E-Liquid:

Savour the irresistible charm of a bakery classic with Lemon Drizzle Longfill E-Liquid. This expertly crafted blend combines the zesty brightness of fresh lemons with the rich, indulgent sweetness of a moist drizzle cake. Each puff brings layers of sugary syrup and soft sponge cake, perfectly capturing the essence of this beloved dessert. It’s a citrus-inspired treat that’s both comforting and vibrant, perfect for those who enjoy dessert and bakery flavors.

What is a Longfill E-Liquid?

Are you in search of higher nicotine strengths in a larger bottle? Longfill E-Liquids might be for you! What exactly is a 60ml Longfill? It’s a 60ml bottle that includes 30ml of flavour concentrate (in your choice of 50VG/50PG or 70VG/30PG), allowing for customisation of nicotine strengths. These are paired with the correct set of 10ml nicotine boosters to create your desired strength.

How to use:

  1. First, choose your preferred nicotine strength and ratio. We recommend 70/30 for higher-powered sub-ohm devices, and 50/50 for smaller MTL/pod kit devices.
  2. Next, add the provided ingredients – nicotine and/or booster shots – into the 60ml Longfill bottle.
  3. Finally, shake well, leave to stand for a few minutes, and it’s ready for you to enjoy.

Please note: Longfills are not ready to use and require mixing before use. For more details, visit our Simplified Guide To Longfills.

description:
Grape E-liquid 1500mg 50ml:

Enjoy the positive effects of CBD, quickly and easily with our premium-quality, organic CBD Isolate Grape E-Liquid 1500mg 50ml. Supreme CBD’s Grape E-Liquid 1500mg 50ml provides a healthy dose of CBD, allowing you to experience all the positive effects on the mind and body. A CBD E-Liquid that’s jam-packed with a fruity grape flavor, reminiscent of the popular USA grape Fanta flavor. A mouth-watering grape explosion that results is a fresh, vibrant flavor that your taste buds will love. Our Grape E-liquid 1500mg 50ml is an absolute must for grape Fanta fans!

This 50ml E-Liquid contains 1500mg of our high-quality CBD Isolate. Mixed to a 60VG/40PG ratio this makes it perfect for use in a sub-ohm device as well as lower power kits. Vaping CBD, as opposed to other methods, speeds up the time it takes for your body to begin feeling its effects meaning it is a quick, easy way to get your daily dose of CBD.

The CBD in these flavored liquids is formulated using a specialist CO2 process that has been developed to isolate and remove any unwanted compounds while creating the maximum potency level of Phyto cannabinoids. Cutting-edge technology is employed to ensure you get a product that includes the highest levels of CBD. Our hemp-based Phyto cannabinoids offer an organic, non-GMO formulation with no chemical solvents.

Our CBD products are derived from premium quality hemp strains and are all third-party lab tested to ensure they are of the highest quality.

 

What is CBD?

CBD is a substance that is derived from the hemp plant. Following filtration and distillation to break apart the individual components, a cannabinoid-rich oil is produced, which is more well-known as cannabidiol or CBD. CBD is the non-psychoactive part of the hemp plant, which means you can experience all the positive effects without experiencing the dizzying ‘high’ feeling.

 

What is CBD Isolate?

CBD isolate is pure CBD which has been specially processed to effectively isolate the CBD from the rest of the compounds in the hemp plant. This means it contains no THC – not even trace amounts – which means you can enjoy your CBD E-liquid safe in the knowledge that it won’t have any psychoactive effects on the body. It’s also ideal for athletes or those worried about drug testing, as even though our full-spectrum CBD products contain less than 0.2% THC which has no psychoactive effects and is 100% legal in the EU and UK, CBD isolate has no traces of THC whatsoever.

 

INGREDIENTS:

Vegetable Glycerin (60%), Mono-Propylene Glycol (40%), Flavorings, Cannabidiol Isolate (1500mg per 50ml)

*Contains 0mg Nicotine

What do the terms VG and PG mean?

VG stands for Vegetable Glycerin, which is typically made from palm oils or coconut oils, it is an odorless liquid that has a mild taste to the tongue. Whereas PG is an acronym for Propene Glycerol. It can be used as an ingredient in foods or cosmetic products.

The ratio of Vegetable Glycerin to Propene Glycerol is 60:40 within the 50ml bottle. This allows the perfect base to effectively infuse CBD and allows it to quickly absorb into the body. This ratio also provides the optimal balance between CBD delivery and delicious grape flavor.

 

Why use Supreme CBD Grape E-Liquid 1500MG 50ML?

  • Vaping CBD is the quickest most effective method of delivering CBD into the body, so it provides fast-acting results.
  • A quick and easy way to get CBD into the body.
  • Enjoy a delicious grape flavour.
  • Contains 0% THC, so it has no psychoactive effects, so you can use the Supreme CBD Grape E-Liquid and go about your day as normal. It is also 100% legal in the UK and EU.
  • Great for people who struggle to swallow pills or dislike the earthy taste of full-spectrum CBD.
  • Great for discreet usage, as you can simply add to your usual vaping device and vape as normal, without anyone knowing you are using a CBD E-liquid.
  • Supreme CBD Grape E-Liquid 1500mg 50ml provides a healthy dose of CBD, ideal for both beginners and more experienced users of CBD.

 

How to use Supreme CBD’s Grape E-liquid 1500mg 50ml and suggested dosage:

Shake well before adding into your desired vaping device or e-cigarette kit and enjoy an easy way to get your daily dose of CBD. Fill the tank of your device as you usually would and this CBD E-liquid can be vaped as normal and used as needed. Remember to start slowly and build up your dosage until you find what’s right for you. If you take too much too soon, the long-term effects won’t be as prevalent.

Not for use by persons under the age of 18.

 

CERTIFICATE OF ANALYSIS:

All of our products are manufactured in a controlled GMP certified lab using industry-leading CO2 extraction methods. These products are continually tested for accuracy, cannabinoid profiles and pesticides in an independent laboratory. Lab reports are available upon request.

Are you in search of higher nicotine strengths in a larger bottle? Longfill E-Liquids might be for you! What exactly is a 60ml Long fill? It’s a 60ml bottle that includes 30ml of flavor concentrate (in your choice of 50VG/50PG or 70VG/30PG), allowing for customization of nicotine strengths. name: 12mg Tens 50/50 10ml (50VG/50PG) - (Full Box) Pack Of 10
description:
Bringing their range of superbly crafted flavours made to offer all day vaping experiences, these Tens 50/50 12mg Freebase E-liquids offer a variety of truly mouth-watering flavourful blends including various fruits, sweets and desserts to deliver lasting tastes that will make quite the impression on any self-respecting vaper’s taste buds. All flavours under this range are available in 12mg nicotine strength so both experienced and starter vapers to experience any flavour they wish.

 

Like with all freebase e-liquids, all Tens 50/50 liquids are mixed a balanced ratio of 50VG/50PG, making them suited for Mouth To Lung (MTL) vaping pods and kits which will allow for the nicotine to be absorbed faster and last longer inside. Vapers will experience both a smooth hit to the throat along with a perfectly balanced mix of strong flavour and vapour cloud production.

Each flavour of the Tens 50/50 range of freebase e-liquids each come in a dispenser box of 10.

– Made In The UK

– 12mg Freebase E-liquid

– 10ml Bottle

– 50VG/50PG

– Ideal for Mouth to Lung (MTL) Vaping Pods & Kits

– Childproof Cap & Tamper Evident Seal

– Recyclable Bottle & Box

– TPD Compliant

Flavors:
American Red
American Red is a truly traditional tobacco flavor and a proven favorite with long term vapers and people who have decided to make the switch. For many people having a familiar taste can ease the transition and help stop smoking.

Apple & Watermelon
Fresh Apple and juicy ripe watermelon are the perfect combination here, occasionally one without the other can just feel a little bland so the mix gives just the right amount of fresh mouth-watering sweetness and a tiny bite from the apple rounds it off perfectly.

Berried Up
Berried up brings you a great mix here. Two types of blueberries, two types of raspberries, two types of blackcurrant and to top it off a nice cool hit of ice. So if you’re a fan of mixed berries you need to give this a try and you’ll understand why it’s called berried up.

Black Ice
Another firm favourite in the vaping community, black ice takes a base of fizzy lemonade sherbet and boosts that flavour out the park with a cool hitting blackcurrant menthol. Thousands of vapers can’t be wrong so if you haven’t tried it yet maybe it’s time you did.

Bubblegum
Bubblegum is a flavour that everyone will know and love, it’s hard to put your finger on the actual taste here but it’s one of all kinds of fruits, others will say something completely different. To us it’s simply pink bubblegum.

Fruit Pastilles
Another flavour that has stood the test of time, fruit pastilles speaks for itself, a gummy mix of fruits including blackcurrant, lemon, strawberry, lime and orange. A gummy fruit lovers dream in a vape.

Fruit Pastilles Ice
For the lovers of that gummy blackcurrant, lemon, strawberry, lime and orange who also enjoy a bit of an icy blast! The usual fruit pastilles flavor you know and love just with a cold hit to finish it off nicely.

Fruity Blackjack
Take your everyday blackjack, the twist on a liquorice, add some pineapple chunks into the mix and it turns what was already a great flavor more delicious! With a bit of an added ice this could just well be your new all day vape.

Grape Crush
We’ve all had grape soda, many have had a grape slush. So Tens have decided to throw it all into the crusher! The results were amazing so they present you with Tens Grape Crush! Two types of grape are better than one! A nice crushed ice chill.

Key Lime Cookie Butter
The name says it all, the type of luscious battery cookie treat you would find in a artisan delicatessen. Don’t mistake this for your run of the mill biscuit. Only the best ingredients have gone into this mix and they came out of the oven perfectly baked, the key lime is divine.

Mental Menthol
When you love that menthol flavor but you just want that extra icy kick that’s exactly what mental menthol gives you. A real punch of coldness to clear the airways and even delete vapers tongue!

Peach Mango Lychee
Honey peaches, alphonso mangoes and ha-kip lychees mixed together perfectly to create quite the exotic cocktail to tempt even the most fussy of vapers. Fill up your tank or pod system and travel to the tropics.

Polo Mint
No holes here, just a very traditional mixed mint that has a very distinguished flavor. The mint for the minty connoisseur. Fresh with a capital F on the inhale and exhale.

R-WHY-4
Why 4? History says that it was the 4th blend version of the original ruyan flavor, Hence RY4 came about. We’ve played with the formulation a little, still keeping the original tobacco, vanilla and caramel just jazzing it up. with a creamier caramel and a full vanilla. If you’re a fan of RY4 give Tens’ R-WHY-4 a shot!

Raspberry
Every now and then a standalone flavour just works, this is one of them. Tens have selected the most succulent, juicy and sweet raspberries we could find to bring to you in the form of Tens’ Raspberry e-liquid.

Rhubarb Crumble
Lip puckering phubarb, but not in the tart way, sweetened and cooked to perfection to make a soft base. Topped off with a thick layer of the nicest sweet and buttery crumble you could imagine. An amazing dessert that you can vape to your heart’s content without worrying about the calories.

Slush
This puppy is gonna get ya! The original blue slush with crushed ice, Tens have taken a few variations of raspberries and blueberries and even tweaked the tice with this one to make the ultimate full flavour blue icy drink we could. Sadly though this will not change the colour of your tongue.

Strawberry
Simply strawberry, just like when you go fruit picking and full up the punnets with the ripest, plumpest and brightest strawberries you can find knowing they are just for you. Only the best will do and here it is in e-liquid form. It’s mouth-watering.

Triple Mint
Decisions, decisions, Tens has made them for you. Triple Mint has the best of all worlds. A refreshing strong menthol base mint, peppermint to add a warm edge and finally a really sweet spearmint to add the soft but undeniable flavour it is. A triple flavour that’s a triple hit! A winner for the menthol lovers out there.

Ultra Violet
When there is only 1 name you could call a flavour, Ultra Violet from Tens is an amazing mix of parma violets with a soft sweet bing cherry and a nice glug of pink lemonade. You need to try this just to see how well it works. This isn’t a middle of the road flavour, it’s Ultra!

Vinto
Vinto is the perfect take on an extremely popular drink, a mix of juices from grapes, raspberries and blackcurrants with a secret blend of herbs and spices. A great vape to please all the fruity followers. If you enjoy this you have to try Tens’ Vinto Ice!

Vinto Ice
Vinto Ice, the cold version of the popular Vinto in the Tens 50/50 range. Juices from grapes, raspberries and blackcurrant with a secret blend of herbs and spices. All that with a nice icy hit on both the inhale and exhale make this a really refreshing vape experience.

Walter Blue
Walter Blue, a moreish flavour made up with a mix of tasty blackjack, blackcurrant menthol and an additional hit of ice. A flavour that has stood the test of time here and been a firm favourite of many. If you enjoy Walter Blue don’t forget to also have a look at Tens’ Walter Red.

Walter Red
Walter Red, a slightly different take on the popular Walter Blue. A top blend of tasty blackjack, blackcurrant menthol, ripe strawberries and not forgetting that hit of ice. Another proven flavour and very popular. It’s Walter Blue with strawberries for those who like a more berry type of flavour.

description:
Boveda

Boveda keeps your herb fresh by regulating the humidity inside your herb container. To use Boveda simply place the it in a air tight container with your herb. This will ensure your herb stays as fresh as possible for as long as possible.

Fight The Mould

Possibly the worst thing that can happen to herb is a mould infestation. This can render your favourite herb useless and unsafe to use.

Boveda eliminates the chance of mould and also stops any existing mould from further growing. This is done by keeping the humidity below the point in which mould accelerates its growth.

Don’t Risk Your Health! Never consume herb with any presence of mould.

Improved Appearance & Aroma

Boveda Also helps to retain both the rich aromas of your herb as well as hold onto some of those vibrant colours your herb might have.

Retains Potency 15% Better

Studies conducted by a independent laboratory in California have found that herb stored with Boveda retains 15% more potency then other general storage alternatives.

 

No Harmful Chemicals

Each Boveda contains a solution of purified water and natural salt. Within a closed container Boveda maintains a predetermined level of (RH) by releasing or absorbing purified water-vapor, as needed, through the membrane.

Individually Sealed

Boveda now comes individually sealed making it a lot easier to store boveda that is not in use. This means that you don’t have to store you boveda in a sealed container when you are not using it.

name: Blurple/gold XL Vortex & Intercooler Plus Titanium Tip
sourceName: Blurple/gold XL Vortex & Intercooler Plus Titanium Tip
description:
XL Vortex & Intercooler

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

Take your dynavap experience to the next level with the all titanium Vortex by Simrell Collection. A true premium stem that has been crafted to the highest quality.

Please Note: Cap Not Included

Anodising done in house at HTV

What makes the Vortex so special

Besides the beautiful understated design there is quite a bit going on with this stem.

Offset Teardrop Airport : This is where things get interesting. Because the airport is offset to the side, when air enters it immediately spirals around the inner tube towards the dynavap tip creating a vortex. This helps cool the inner tube and also helps pull vapour from the herb chamber. The teardrop airport also enables easy adjustment to the amount of air that is let in through the airport.

The Intercooler : The intercooler is made from medical grade titanium and is another key feature to the Vortex Stem. Once the air from the airport and vapour have met up at the base of the dynavap tip it then is sent through the spiraled intercooler. This lengthens the vapour path considerably which aids in the cooling and conditioning of your vapour.

Summary

To summarise the vortex experience is not that easy to put into words. If you are well accustomed to the dynavap experience then you will quickly notice the differences. There is truly something magical going on with the vortex and huge credit has to go to Austyn the creator for putting yet another great dynavap compatible product out there for us all to enjoy.

The Vortex is a great option for the dynavap lover. Particularly if you have previous experience with other dynavap vaporizers. If this is to be your first vapcap then some of its charm may not be so well defined without having used other vapcaps.

Included

  • 1 x Simrell XL Vortex & Intercooler
  • 1 x Storage Tube
  • 1 x Titanium Tip

name: Black Wood XL Vortex & Intercooler Vapcap
sourceName: Black Wood XL Vortex & Intercooler Vapcap
description:
Black Wood XL Vortex & Intercooler

NON ELECTRIC FLAME POWERED DEVICE

Take your dynavap experience to the next level with the Black Wood Vortex by Simrell Collection. A true premium stem that has been crafted to the highest quality.

The use of black wood really brings a lot of comfort to your fingers and lips while in use. Wood does not heat up nearly as much as the titanium version so longer sessions do not lead to a uncomfortably hot stem.

What makes the Vortex so special

Besides the beautiful understated design there is quite a bit going on with this stem.

Offset Teardrop Airport : This is where things get interesting. Because the airport is offset to the side, when air enters it immediately spirals around the inner tube towards the dynavap tip creating a vortex. This helps cool the inner tube and also helps pull vapour from the herb chamber. The teardrop airport also enables easy adjustment to the amount of air that is let in through the airport.

The Intercooler : The intercooler is made from medical grade titanium and is another key feature to the Vortex Stem. Once the air from the airport and vapour have met up at the base of the dynavap tip it then is sent through the spiralled intercooler. This lengthens the vapour path considerably which aids in the cooling and conditioning of your vapour.

Summary

To summarize the vortex experience is not that easy to put into words. If you are well accustomed to the dynavap experience then you will quickly notice the differences. There is truly something magical going on with the vortex and huge credit has to go to Austyn the creator for putting yet another great dynavap compatible product out there for us all to enjoy.

The Vortex is a great option for the dynavap lover, particularly if you have previous experience with other dynavap vaporizers. If this is to be your first vapcap then some of its charm may not be so well defined without having used other vapcaps. Still, you can’t go wrong with a vortex.

Included

  • 1 x Simrell Black Wood XL Vortex & Intercooler
  • 1 x Storage Tube
  • 1 x DynaVap Titanium Tip
  • 1 x DynaVap Cap
